body.brief_preview: Implement Maddie v4 from these specs. CRITICAL: constraints inheritance-semantics-001 and auth-friction-001 MUST be expressed in the produced code. The api-implementer code must include /v1/inheritanc

compliance_findings.evidence: UI artifact: auth-screen uses a magic-link flow with a single 'btn-magic' button; no <input type='text'> or token-paste field is rendered; comment explicitly states '/* Hidden helper — NO token paste field is ever rendered */'. API artifact: POST /v1/invite creates a magic link delivered via SMS/email; GET /v1/auth/magic/<invite_token> binds a SUBJECT_TOKEN into an httpOnly cookie on a single click (redirect to /v1/ui/main); no password, username, or manual token entry endpoint exists. The elder taps one link and is authenticated — token binding runs entirely behind the one-tap surface.

API artifact begins to define inheritance-related code: VALID_MARKS = ('FAMILY_SHARED', 'PRIVATE_ONLY', 'TRUSTEE_HOLD'), STATE_ORDER = ['ALIVE', 'DEATH_CLAIM_FILED', 'DEATH_VERIFIED', 'ESTATE_UNLOCKED', 'STORIES_DISTRIBUTED'], and a partial /inheritance/beneficiaries POST endpoint — but the artifact is truncated mid-line ('data = request'). There is NO complete lifecycle policy artifact: no specification of which family members receive which stories, no trigger conditions for state transitions (e.g., what constitutes DEATH_VERIFIED, who initiates ESTATE_UNLOCKED), no access-control matrix mapping beneficiary roles to story marks, no dispute/revocation semantics, and no standalone policy document. The constraint explicitly requires a 'full lifecycle policy artifact' and states that 'stub field in API is not evidence.' What exists is exactly that — stub constants and an incomplete endpoint.
